en.io: Accepts UI design requirements or refactoring objectives as input and produces idiomatic SwiftUI component code and architecture guidance.
en.boundary: It does not cover backend system architecture, complete non-UI business logic implementation, or non-Apple UI frameworks.
scenarios: Designing navigation and tab structures using TabView and NavigationStack
Managing view state and data flow using modern SwiftUI constructs like @State, @Binding, and @Observable
Implementing custom UI components such as dynamic sheets, responsive stacks, and scroll-driven reveal animations

zh.io: 接收 UI 设计需求或视图重构目标作为输入，输出符合规范的 SwiftUI 组件实现与架构建议。
zh.boundary: 它不涉及后端系统架构、独立的非 UI 业务逻辑实现或非 Apple 平台的 UI 框架开发。
scenarios: 使用 TabView 和 NavigationStack 设计应用导航与 Tab 架构
使用 @State、@Binding 及 @Observable 等 SwiftUI 属性包装器管理视图状态与数据流
实现动态 Sheet 弹窗、响应式布局以及滚动驱动的交互组件
